name: ActivityPageHeader
description: Compact mobile navigation for campaign and editorial landing pages with the approved YAMI lockup, a page title, search and cart actions.

figma.notes: YAMI UI/UX Guidelines H5 Page8 mobile navigation. The supplied node defines only the 402x56 mobile form.

title.description: Short campaign or page title, truncated to one centered line.

locale.description: Content locale. Mobile navigation keeps the approved English YAMI Logo-UI lockup in every locale.

homeHref.description: Optional home destination for the brand lockup.

brand.note: Consumes the locked Mobile Logo-UI assets; the mark and wordmark are never assembled in code.

focus.note: Brand and action controls use the shared token-backed focus ring.

tapTarget.note: Figma's 40px visible actions retain a 44px hit area.

accessibility.role: banner with page heading and two named actions
accessibility.ariaPattern: native h1 plus named search and cart buttons
accessibility.structure: The one-line visible title is the page h1. Icons are decorative inside explicitly named buttons.
accessibility.interaction: Search and cart are native buttons with visible focus treatment.
